run_policy.protocol: Present each prompt as a Skill-selection task using only the installed names and descriptions declared for the condition. Open every selected SKILL.md so loading is observable, report selected names, and do not solve the underlying task.
run_policy.repetition_rule: Run the candidate on every affected case first. Run the matching current condition only where comparison is decision-relevant, and repeat only when variation, an unexpected result, model differences, or failure impact makes another observation decision-relevant.
run_policy.verdict_rule: The observed loaded Skill set must equal the expected set. Record pass, fail, unstable, not exposed, or not executed for every case.
